requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity features, scan workflow automation, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to simplify business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: To deliver breakthrough productivity and ease of management, differentiating HP from competitors and addressing SMB customer needs for efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration and SMB portal support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered productivity, scan, and management features are available and verifiable in the product UI; features function as documented and pass UAT.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver the lowest total cost of ownership for SMBs among HP business printers, including minimal intervention and optimized consumables.
requirements.Rationale: To attract cost-conscious SMBs and compete effectively in the CISS PLE Hi segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires optimized hardware, ink tank design, and efficient consumables.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO calculations demonstrate lower ownership costs than previous HP models and key competitors in third-party benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that customers can easily swap without technical support, reducing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses new SMB customer segment needs and reduces reliance on service centers, increasing customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Design must ensure ease of replacement and minimal risk of error.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customer can replace maintenance box within 5 minutes using only supplied instructions; no tools required; validated in usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Utilize uniquely keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility, reducing user error and warranty claims.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces support costs due to incorrect ink usage.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle design and printer detection mechanism.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are physically keyed and only compatible with intended slots; verified in QA and field tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated SMB portal for managing multiple printers, targeting unmanaged or lightly managed SMBs without dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Rationale: Enables easy fleet management for SMBs, a key differentiator for Magellan.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend infrastructure and secure authentication.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, supports management of at least 15 printers, and passes security and usability tests.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan is compatible with HP's PaaS offerings, enabling subscription-based services and remote management features.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's business model shift and customer demand for flexible, scalable solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan can be provisioned, managed, and monitored via HP PaaS platform; validated in integration testing.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Provide full PDL (Page Description Language) and PostScript support for the PDL SKU, with print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improvement over current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Enables compatibility with business printing workflows and differentiates Magellan in the SMB segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and driver development for PDL/PS support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm in standardized print tests; PDL/PS compatibility validated with common business software.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Achieve Blue Angel environmental certification for the PDL SKU, demonstrating commitment to sustainability and eco-friendly design.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory requirements and enhances appeal to environmentally conscious SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and materials must meet Blue Angel criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Certification is obtained and documented prior to launch.

requirements.Title: 80k/2 Year Warranty
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Provides peace of mind for SMB customers and aligns with market expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires reliability testing and service planning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published and supported; warranty claims tracked for compliance.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: PHA and MINK
requirements.Description: Enable customer-replaceable PHA components and MINK at service centers, with a target of making MINK customer-replaceable if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs, improving SMB satisfaction and lowering HP support burden.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design for easy replacement; documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA and MINK can be replaced per service guide; validated in field trials.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI algorithms for print and scan quality enhancement, ensuring optimal output with minimal user intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers superior print/scan quality and differentiates Magellan from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration and hardware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features demonstrably improve print/scan quality in benchmark tests; user satisfaction >90% in surveys.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% RCP Content
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Appeals to environmentally conscious customers and aligns with HP sustainability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain and manufacturing process updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product Bill of Materials demonstrates 60% RCP; verified by third-party audit.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing workflows through the HP App, enabling users to print from smartphones and tablets.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses modern SMB mobility needs and enhances user convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from iOS and Android HP Apps; feature passes cross-device testing.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for remote diagnostics, usage tracking, and predictive maintenance, aligned with HP enterprise standards.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, reduces downtime, and supports PaaS business model.
requirements.Dependencies: Backend infrastructure and secure data handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is available in the SMB portal and HP support tools; GDPR compliance verified.
